title: Why this project hub exists
summary: Grounded draft that explains the site as a project hub without inventing business claims.
bodyMarkdown:
Grinning Frog works better as a project hub than a generic landing page because the useful thing is the map: what is live, what is planned, and where a visitor should go next.

The active destination is the music node, while notes and lab-style experiments can grow around it over time. That structure lets the site stay weird, technical, and signal-themed without pretending every lane is already a polished product.

The goal is simple: preserve the CRT-green Grinning Frog identity, route people to the work that exists now, and leave enough room for future experiments to appear without rebuilding the whole site every time.
groundingNotes: Workspace is classified as a personal/project hub.
Music node is the active destination.
Brand voice is retro, technical, playful, and signal/transmission themed.
approvalNotes: Review before publishing to confirm wording matches the owner's intended voice.
